discrepancy_summary: The Lan-DeMets (1983) spending function 2 - 2*Phi(1.95996/sqrt(t)) incorporates a symmetric reflection factor and two-sided critical value constant Z_{0.025} while evaluating a strictly one-sided non-inferiority hypothesis. Pure one-sided spending 1 - Phi(1.64485/sqrt(t)) spends alpha 3.19x faster at Look 1.
regulatory_directive: Neither formula may be used to authorize candidate promotion until pre-registered consensus is established. Equal observed recall on 8 events (62.50%) or 11 events (27.27%) cannot be treated as confirmatory non-inferiority.
